title: Google Just Set an END Date for Assistant on Nest 😳
description:
Google Assistant is leaving your Nest speaker — on August 2, 2027.

Google announced on 20 Nov 2026 that Gemini for Home will fully replace Google Assistant on its speakers and smart displays, and that the Nest app shuts down on January 25, 2027 (everything moves to the Google Home app). Google says the upgrade is free and every device supported today keeps working. The catch: once your home switches to Gemini, you can't switch back, Gemini Live needs Google Home Premium (from $10/month in the US), and older speakers like the original Google Home don't get Gemini Live.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 60/100 → SPEC, if you want smarter answers. Not if you loved simple commands.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
